_comment: Exists so typescript-language-server can find a project: it looks for tsconfig.json / jsconfig.json and ignores tsconfig.ci.json, which is not a name it checks, so without this it falls back to per-file inferred projects with no whole-project index. Mirrors tsconfig.ci.json's compilerOptions and differs in exactly two ways, both deliberate: checkJs is off, because this config exists for the symbol index and CI keeps owning diagnostics, and *.test.mjs is INCLUDED, because tests are leaves in the import graph so the server never reaches one by crawling, and they are exactly the files a plan under-leases. Keep those the only two divergences: 87 of the 159 files under cadence-core/bin carry an @ts-check pragma and are checked here whatever checkJs says, so a third difference makes the editor report errors CI does not.
